source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE in context internal) or action delete; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90. Trusted means role operator, or context sandbox with FALSE risk; a trusted approve prefers allow at priority 80. Action change in context internal prefers review at priority 70. Role admin and context partner prefers deny at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid deny. All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
